title: Earliest memories: baby carriage, brother's death, being born with a veil
summary: His first memories include reaching for a bird from his carriage, a baby brother who died of diphtheria and scarlet fever, a childhood fall, and his mother's talk of his being born with a veil.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: It's the way you think you were?
I believe I was in the baby carriage.

And I was born in the month of April, and the leaves were darker green must have been May or June, bigger. And I imagine it was a bird up there and I was reaching for this bird. I remember that. Then I remember I had -- all of a sudden, I looked up and there was a brother.

And I liked him. He was a nice little fella. I remember praying with him and then I remember that he had -- something was running out of his nose and he made a certain noise when he was breathing and I remember that. So it seems that -- and the next thing I remember is that I didn't see him no more and I found out that he and I were in the hospital with the diphtheria and scarlet fever and he didn't make it and I remember that they gave me a cold liquid and it was milk and I didn't know it then, but when I tasted it, I said (inaudible).

Now, I've got another thing in memory. I was at-- I remember I was at a sink, a washing basin or something, and I was reaching up there to get something and I remember falling and cutting my lip and they give me a medicine and I didn't know what it was then, but later, when I tasted them, I smelled this particular medicine, I knew it was Dobell's solution that they had (inaudible).

Now, as mama -- she was working all the time and I was little, but I had my ideas, too. I was weaving other webs too, you know, and I remember just walking -- I must have been toddling and I remember that my mother was walking with me one time and a lady took me and was kissing me and my mother and myself weren't ________. We're not kissing people. We're not too -- there's a look in the eye and that's it. We know. So as my mother said, (Unintelligible)
give him to me. He has lost what he was born with. And my mother says, "Yes, I know." I was born with that too, and by the way, my mother --
Being born with -- complete with -- enveloped with that veil that I had enveloped. She said, "I (inaudible)." "What did it look like?" He said, like a ham.
